sentence: This project builds models that use automated speech and language analysis to track psychosis severity over time.
This project studies the brain pathways and mechanisms involved in socially transmitted aggression.
This project studies how an innate immune sensor helps control pain in steady-state conditions and in head and neck cancer.
This project develops a noninvasive treatment that uses an antimicrobial enzyme to cross the intact eardrum and kill the Streptococcus pneumoniae that cause middle-ear infections.
This project tries to find out which DNA damage causes the unexplained patterns of mutations seen in cancer genomes.
This project tries to find out why cellular therapy sometimes fails in large B-cell lymphoma and how tumor genomic composition drives resistance.
This project tests the anti-cancer effects and possible toxicities of a radioimmunotherapy that attacks a target on acute myeloid leukemia cells.
This project studies inhibitors and degraders as a treatment for Ewing sarcoma.
This project improves methods of cryo electron microscopy and tomography to image cells and molecules at high resolution.
This project studies how ethanol dependence and withdrawal change stress systems in the amygdala, and how these changes differ by sex.
This project examines biological and environmental contributors to neurodevelopmental disorders and potential therapies.
This project uses proteomic and cell biology techniques to find the proteins that interact with two main isoforms of Wilms’ tumor 1.
This project sequences epigenetic signatures in cell-free DNA from blood plasma to detect colorectal cancer early.
This project tests whether disrupted circadian rhythms in muscle make it harder to adapt to nutrient stress in obesity and aging.
This project tests whether inhalation of exosomes from lung stem cells can treat pulmonary fibrosis.
This project offers confocal and electron microscopy imaging for studies of cell membranes, signal transduction and vascular cell biology.
This project studies how a protein lets glioblastoma stem cells grow in tumor niches and tests the effect of inhibiting it.
This project builds a single-cell technology that measures proteins, protein complexes and mRNA in thousands of individual cells to study immune signaling.
This project builds a digital twin algorithm that uses AI to simulate and predict the results of phonosurgery.
This project measures chemicals in pregnancy samples to find how chemical exposures relate to gestational diabetes and adverse pregnancy outcomes.
